RankingEntry.title: RankingEntry
RankingEntry.description: Public, immutable walk run ranking record containing only non-PII gameplay metrics and player-chosen character display name.

userId.description: Locally generated anonymous guest player ID (no account login required) or Firebase UID.

characterName.description: Player-entered character display name or auto-assigned sequential default name (e.g. 땡콩1, 땡콩2).

stageId.description: Walk route stage number (1: 산책로, 2: 숲속 오솔길, 3: 저녁 카페거리, 4: 무한 질주).

score.description: Final run score in points (0 to 999999).

distance.description: Final distance walked in meters (0 to 999999).

outcome.description: Whether Ddaengkong-i completed the stage walk or returned home early.

treatsCollected.description: Total treats collected during the run (0 to 9999).

maxCombo.description: Highest treat combo achieved during the run (0 to 9999).

isPublic.description: Must be true to surface the non-PII record on the public leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the ranking entry was recorded.

NameCounter.title: NameCounter
NameCounter.description: Monotonically incrementing counter used to assign sequential default character names per character (땡콩1, 땡콩2 / 나리1, 나리2 / 키키1, 키키2).

count.description: Current issued sequential integer starting at 1.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp of the latest counter increment.

/rankings/{entryId}.description: Public online leaderboard entries storing immutable non-PII walk results.

/counters/{counterId}.description: Global sequential counter documents (counters/defaultName for 땡콩이, counters/defaultName_nari for 나리, counters/defaultName_kiki for 키키) for unnamed player IDs.
